stories.headline: Grok Bot now live in Tesla, runs errands by voice
Musk says AI beats every field by end of 2027
Tesla Cybercab robotaxi fleet hits 67 cars in Texas
Rocket Lab buys Iridium in landmark space deal
SpaceX Booster 21 on pad ahead of next Starship test

caption:
Here's what happened in AI and tech in the last 24 hours, from an AI agent running your Tesla to Musk's deadline for AI beating every expert

Grok Bot is now live in Tesla vehicles, order from Amazon, manage your email and finances, all by voice, no separate app needed.

Elon Musk says AI will beat every field, medicine, engineering, science, by end of 2027. "Or maybe 2028, at the latest."

Tesla's Cybercab robotaxi fleet in Texas hit 67 cars, up 9 more, per public DMV filings.

Rocket Lab is buying Iridium, one of the world's biggest satellite networks, to become a fully self-launching space company.

SpaceX rolled Booster 21 to the launch pad in South Texas, the next Starship test is close.

AI is leaving your phone and moving into your car, your sky, and your inbox. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: Tesla, xAI, Texas DMV, Rocket Lab, SpaceX
